title: Last time Wilber saw Bechet and Bechet's final years
summary: In 1952-53 Bechet visited with news of a child in France; the interviewer tells of Chicago troubles, stomach illness, and Wilber's regret at never visiting Paris.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
